messages:
maria.g: Quick sync — we need to finalize customer comms after last night's partial outage. Who owns the 72h summary and statuspage phrasing?
ryan.k: I can draft statuspage + a short one-paragraph summary. Will keep it non-technical.
samir.b: I'll take the RCA sharing policy + a redaction checklist.
beth: looping in @olivia.p for legal review on sharing rules and any consent language.
olivia.p: On it. I can review policy + consent template; aim to return comments by EOD tomorrow.
maria.g: Must-haves: (1) 72h customer summary, (2) statuspage line that doesn't expose infra internals, (3) 3-Q FAQ for support, (4) clear criteria for full RCA access.
ryan.k: Draft statuspage (v0):
"Partial disruption to hosted inference (Mar 24, 2026) — some requests experienced delays following a configuration change. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. We are preparing a customer summary and will post an update within 72 hours."
maria.g: Nice. Replace 'configuration change' with 'configuration rollout' and swap 'delays' -> 'service delays' for clarity. Avoid mentioning 'cache' explicitly.
ryan.k: Updated: "...following a configuration rollout that affected request caching behavior." Is 'caching behavior' too deep?
maria.g: Yes, drop implementation terms. Use: 'that affected request handling.'
samir.b: RCA sharing proposal:
- Full internal RCA: internal only.
- Redacted customer summary: publish within 72 hours to impacted customers.
- Detailed timeline + mitigations: redacted version available within 7 business days.
Redaction checklist: remove PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, and sensitive security controls.
olivia.p: Legal ok with that. Require documented customer consent for any deeper technical attachments and record consent in our ticketing system.
beth: I'll draft a short consent checkbox + opt-in for a post-incident technical call for enterprise customers.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-5010 "Publish 72h customer summary" — assignee: maria.g — due: 1769980000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-5011 "Statuspage copy update" — assignee: ryan.k — due: 1769850000
maria.g: Recurring-pattern note: infra flagged this as third cache-related tail event in 6 weeks. Public line should say "we are investigating a recurring class of incidents and will share mitigations once validated." Keep it short.
ryan.k: Will append that sentence once legal signs off.
samir.b: I'll add a recurring-incident tag and link the infra ticket INFRA-772 so any customer who requests deeper info sees the same summary.
olivia.p: Agree to the language. For customers requesting full RCAs we must have NDA/consent; create a template consent log entry.
beth: I'll create the consent template and a support flow doc with the opt-in checkbox.
maria.g: Owners recap: statuspage + sentence: ryan.k (due 2 business days); 72h summary: maria.g (due 72 hours); RCA policy + checklist: samir.b (draft to legal by EOD); consent + template: beth + olivia.p.
incident-bot: COMMS-5012 created: "RCA policy & redaction checklist" — assignee: samir.b — due: 1769900000
ryan.k: I'll PR the statuspage and tag support for consistent wording.
maria.g: Please post the 72h draft back here when ready for quick review. Keep support replies aligned. End of thread.
